De overeenkomst bestaat uit: het leveren en plaatsen van bovengrondse verzamelcontainers; legen en onderhouden van deze containers; het inzamelen, overslaan, sorteren, vermarkten en/of het (laten) verwerken van het ingezamelde textiel; het periodiek rapporteren over de uitgevoerde werkzaamheden. Bij de uitvoering van de opdracht wordt gebruik gemaakt van de landelijke wel/niet lijst opgenomen in Circulair Materialenplan, hoofdstuk Materialen-Textiel.  Voor het inzamelen en voor de verwerking van het textiel zouden separate overeenkomsten gesloten kunnen worden. Dit kan tot gevolg hebben dat er met verschillende opdrachtnemers een overeenkomst wordt aangegaan. Echter de gemeente wil één opdrachtnemer contracteren zodat de inzameling efficiënt en uniform plaats vindt, en ze één aanspreekpunt krijgt voor het rapporteren, inzamelen, en de verwerking van het textiel. Het gemeentelijk afvalbeleid kan hierdoor effectief en eenvoudig worden gevoerd. Daarmee is de opdracht samengevoegd. Indien de opdracht gesplitst wordt door bijvoorbeeld een perceelindeling, is er meer coördinatie noodzakelijk. Dit brengt extra activiteiten en dus meer (interne) kosten met zich mee. Indien de coördinatie niet optimaal verloopt, kan dit leiden tot minder en slechter textiel, vertraging en daarmee extra overlast voor belanghebbenden (bijvoorbeeld inwoners, medewerkers van de gemeentewerf). Daarbij wordt de gemeente dan ook verantwoordelijk voor de planning en coördinatie van de uitvoering. Omdat dit alles niet in het belang van de gemeente is en haar circulaire doelen, wordt er geen perceelindeling toegepast en worden de werkzaamheden door één opdrachtnemer uitgevoerd. De overeenkomst wordt aangegaan voor een periode van minimaal 4 jaar en maximaal 8 jaar. De ingangsdatum van de overeenkomst is 1 februari 2027. De conceptovereenkomst is als bijlage bij dit aanbestedingsdocument is gevoegd.

Reinforcement Work Simulator The offered simulator can either be a separate reinforcement work simulator or an extension module for a production drilling simulator. The simulator can be a friction, resin, and/or grouted bolt bolting simulator and/or a cable bolting simulator. The tender must take into account the overall implementation of the procurement in accordance with the terms and conditions set out in the invitation to tender. If the total price of one or more simulator types exceeds the estimated price set out in the invitation to tender or other procurement documentation, the contracting entity has the right not to procure the simulator type(s) in question and allocate the funds to one or more other simulator types. The offer must consider the overall implementation of the procurement in accordance with the terms presented in the request for proposal. The bidder may choose to offer simulators for different bolt types separately. The purchaser does not require an offer for all simulator solutions. 3.1 Simulator The reinforcement work simulator must correspond to the equipment used in mines in Finland and Sweden to provide students with a learning experience that mirrors real working life. The simulator must have an authentic control and management system that matches the control systems of machines used in mines. The simulator should, where possible, offer performance monitoring and evaluation to support training (e.g., accuracy, efficiency, safety). 3.2 Hardware The control devices (levers, pedals, buttons, displays) must match the controls of real mining machines, and their response must be as realistic as possible. The simulator must "understand" impossible movements and machine collisions. 3.3 Data Transfer The simulator's data transfer protocol must match that of a real mining machine and include the following topics: Importing and exporting the bolting plan to the machine's measuring device. Loading documentation of the bolting performance. 3.4 Software The purchaser does not require bolting simulator design software, but it is considered an advantage. However, the simulator must include a sufficient number of different exercises and scenarios. If the supplier can integrate design software with the offered simulator, the bolting diagrams must be able to be designed using software commonly used in mines or machine-specific software. If design software is provided with the simulator procurement, a license for bolting diagram design software must be provided to the educational institution for at least five years (from the project's end date of 30.6.2027 to at least 29.6.2032). The offer must state the validity period of the licenses to which the supplier commits. The purchaser commits not to use the software outside the educational institution and not to send completed bolting plans to third parties. The possibility of simulating fault diagnostics and error situations (troubleshooting exercises) and utilizing a mobile application and wireless data transfer is considered an advantage for the procurement package. The simulator software must be updatable with new programs. Additionally, the software must allow for monitoring learning outcomes (scenario reports from various exercises). 3.5 Displays and VR Support The simulator's display(s) must be expandable to modern display technology, enabling the creation of a realistic mining and drilling environment. A solution based solely on VR glasses is not accepted, but the possibility of using them alongside other display technology is considered an advantage. 3.6 Cabin The cabin of a simulator with a cabin must correspond in outline to a real machine. The offer must state whether the simulator package includes a cabin or if it is a desktop model suitable for a classroom or another type of solution. 3.7 Maintenance and Support The simulator supplier must provide sufficient user and maintenance training for the teaching staff and deliver comprehensive user manuals for the simulator and its software. Software updates and extensions must be available for at least five years. The availability of spare parts and maintenance must be ensured for long-term use. The offer must state the availability of spare parts. 3.8 Delivery The supplier is responsible for transporting the simulator to the purchaser (TOP Keskikatu 69, 95400 Tornio), including any transport insurance and agreements. Additionally, the simulator supplier commits to delivering software updates to ensure the simulator meets the requirements of the mining environment well into the future. The offer must state the software update period in years to which the supplier commits. 3.9 Other Matters The goal of the procurement is to provide mining students with work-life-oriented mining education through situations similar to a real working environment in safe and cost-effective simulated conditions and to obtain a flexible and scalable solution for mining education needs, where physical and virtual learning support each other. Additionally, the purchaser is willing to engage in other cooperation and partnership in developing mining education environments with the supplier. The procurement is made based on overall economic affordability (price scoring max 30 p., quality scoring max 70 p.). Offers are also evaluated based on the overall implementation of the simulators to achieve the most functional overall solution for the educational environment, serving students, teaching staff, and industry representatives, to whom mining education provides new skilled workers. The procurement unit has the right to leave the procurement or part of the procurement unmade for a justified and valid reason and leave the procurement contract unmade for one, several, or all parts. Valid reason would be for example, that the allocated budget is exceeded, the procurement becomes unnecessary, or no comparable offers have been received in the tendering competition.

Für die Objektplanungsleistungen bis einschließlich LPH 4 wurde das Büro Hrycyk Architekten GmbH, München (nachfolgend "Büro Hrycyk") beauftragt. Der Bauantrag zur Genehmigung des Betreuungsgebäudes wurde am 23. Juni 2026 ein-gereicht und umfasst die Errichtung eines dreigeschossigen Betreuungsgebäudes.
